A gift is offered in exchange for promotion.

Refer it to the supervisor and check policy.
narration_fil:
May dumating na kinatawan ng isang kumpanya ng gatas sa barangay health station ni BHW Corazon — may dalang mga sample at tarpaulin na nagpapakita ng kanilang bagong produkto. "Puwede po bang ilagay namin ito sa loob, at ipamigay ninyo sa mga nanay? May konting regalo din po kami para sa inyo."

Alam ni Corazon na kailangan niyang tumanggi — pero paano niya ito gagawin nang hindi masamang loob ang bisita, at nang tama ang dahilan niya sa pagtanggi?
narration_en:
A representative from a milk company arrived at BHW Corazon's barangay health station — carrying samples and a tarpaulin showing their new product. "Could we leave these inside, for you to give out to the mothers? We also have a small gift for you."

Corazon knew she had to decline — but how could she do it without offending the visitor, and with the right reasoning behind her refusal?

narration_fil: Nililimitahan ng Milk Code (EO 51) ang promosyon ng saklaw na breastmilk substitutes sa health-care system at mga insentibo sa health workers. Huwag tumanggap ng regalo kapalit ng pagpromote ng mga produktong ito. May etikang tuntunin din sa pharmaceutical promotion: binabanggit ng pinagmulang materyal ang DOH AO 2015-0053. Huwag ituring na magkakapareho ang lahat ng pakikipag-ugnayan sa industriya o mag-apruba ng promosyon nang mag-isa. Idulog ang alok sa namamahala at tiyakin ang kasalukuyang polisiya. Kailangan pang repasuhin ang eksaktong saklaw at exceptions sa pangunahing sanggunian bago ilathala ang draft na ito.
narration_en: The Milk Code (EO 51) restricts promotion of covered breastmilk substitutes in the health-care system and inducements to health workers. Do not accept gifts in exchange for promoting such products. Pharmaceutical promotion also has ethical rules: the source training material cites DOH AO 2015-0053. Do not treat all industry interactions as identical or independently approve a promotion. Refer the offer to the facility supervisor and check the current policy. The exact scope and exceptions of this order still require primary-source review before this draft is published.
